descriptor.adaptation_notes: Single-threaded. Borrowed immutable bulk rows, stable owned insert rows. Exact unsigned-byte semantics. No neural network or hotspot cache. 32-bit record IDs limit total records to UINT32_MAX.

memory.accounting_notes: Capacity-based estimate; borrowed input counted in full. Excludes allocator headers, deque spare blocks/map, transient training/merge allocations. Not peak RSS; IDs/tags are owned, payloads of bulk rows are borrowed.
